key_insight: A welding torch umbilical can be modeled as a constrained multibody system, allowing its dynamic loads on a robot to be predicted and used in robot-motion planning.
engineering_relevance: This matters for lightweight and collaborative welding robots because umbilical-induced forces can alter motion accuracy, actuation effort, and overall dynamic performance.
method: Model the umbilical as a serial chain of rigid bodies with passive joints.
Include elastic and dissipative effects in the joint modeling.
Impose distal-end prescribed motion with holonomic constraints and reduce the dynamics by projecting onto admissible velocities, avoiding Lagrange multipliers.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a planar case study used to illustrate and validate the proposed dynamic formulation.
watch_item: The approach is demonstrated in a planar case, so extension to full 3D industrial setups may require additional modeling and validation.
paper_title: Dynamic Modeling of a Welding Torch Umbilical and Its Impact on Robot Dynamics
